programme.title: E9 - B. Everyone Wants to Direct/Mission to the Sun/The Quilt Club/Swindlin' Wind/Le Quack
programme.desc: A famous film director (actually a zombie) comes to the farm wanting to shoot his next film. Eustace accepts greedily when he is promised money, only to find that the film is just a pretext for the director and his zombie partner to devour Muriel.

programme.title: E12 - Mordecai And The Rigbys/Peeps/Dead At Eight/Skips' Stress/Wall Buddy
programme.desc: When Mordecai and Rigby order T-shirts for their non-existent band (Mordecai and the Rigbys), Margaret mistakes them for actual musicians.

programme.title: E23 - Board Game Empire
programme.desc: Amato and friends find a mysterious board game which transports them into its world, and the only way out is to win.

programme.title: E3 - Brown Bear
programme.desc: Revisit the evolutionary journey of brown bears, from ursid ancestors that dominated the ice ages to today’s modern omnivores. Witness their symbiotic relationship with salmon and the surprisingly interconnected ecosystems they thrive in.

programme.title: E3 - So Long and Thanks for All the Fish
programme.desc: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

programme.title: E4 - The Punks Strike Back
programme.desc: After the dry season lowers the waters, siblings Kimba and Maya risk crossing the river to search for their parents. They run the gauntlet of the densest populations of crocs and hippos in Africa, and face an even greater threat on the other side.

programme.title: E3 - Brown Bear
programme.desc: Revisit the evolutionary journey of brown bears, from ursid ancestors that dominated the ice ages to today’s modern omnivores. Witness their symbiotic relationship with salmon and the surprisingly interconnected ecosystems they thrive in.

programme.title: E3 - So Long and Thanks for All the Fish
programme.desc: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: When a baby mink is abandoned in a store, the team gets to work on some behavioural training. But will this sweet little one be tough enough for the wild when they’re done? Visit with a mange-afflicted coyote who’s enjoying some alone time to heal.

programme.title: E3 - Wanderers of the Lost Forest
programme.desc: Hogsback, South Africa, is home to two fascinating primates: The Samango monkeys and the Cape Parrots. See how they overcome habit loss, travel across town for food, and make the most of a difficult situation.

programme.title: E4 - Baboons of Bambelela
programme.desc: The Bambelela Troop is a successful and gregarious troop of Chacma Baboons that live in a pristine valley in the Waterberg Mountains of South Africa. But they have a problem—they’re not the only baboons around.

programme.title: E2 - Joey's Journey
programme.desc: Wombats are solitary, slow-moving creatures, but breeding time brings out their energy, aggression and lots of play. Meet a southern hairy-nosed wombat named Birri, who’s trying to find a mate, along with a female named Winnie and her joey, Fred.

programme.title: E5 - The Hollow Heart
programme.desc: This is the incredible story of a tree that has been around for eight hundred years… that can withstand the harshest conditions… and that is more loved by insects, birds and animals than any other…the enormous Baobab. Rooted on the savannah of Malilangwe Game Reserve in southern Zimbabwe.

programme.title: E4 - Brisbane Raid
programme.desc: Chase the team as they triage patients from a hoarding case, then free a tangled-up ibis with rescue officers Jo and Chantelle. Check on a baby koala that took a swan dive with vet Mel and play the waiting game with a deadly eastern brown snake.

programme.title: E1 - Trapped at Low Tide
programme.desc: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

programme.title: E1 - A Tale of Two Penguins
programme.desc: At the water’s edge a brave group of male penguins gather, preparing to make the dangerous journey ashore. With many threats ahead, there is safety in number and these petite penguins have important business to attend. It’s time to breed and they must find a burrow before the females arrive.

programme.title: E2 - Untamed West
programme.desc: New Zealand’s West Coast is like nowhere else on Earth. From glacier-covered mountains to rain-drenched native forests to rough frigid seas, the landscape defies belief. Isolated from the rest of the world, this strip of almost untouched wilderness hides a host of endemic animals. Evolutionary castaways, every one of them is a rare ecological jewel. From alpine parrots and shy penguins to mammal-like kiwis and ancient eels. To survive the conditions the wildlife here has to be hardy, cunning and resourceful. programme.title: E10 - Vietnam
programme.desc: Off to Vietnam next, Rooftop and Catfish embark on what may be their most dangerous visit yet. The BMX bikers start their journey relatively tame with a shot of snake blood. However, things quickly escalate from there with the most intense game of frogger they’ve ever played in the Vietnamese streets. From a hospital visit and racing through the Vietcong tunnels to trying fertilized baby bird eggs and relaxing in a boiling hot spring, nothing can prepare the duo for the ending of their trip heading to the demilitarized zone to detonate bombs. After this trip to Vietnam, what more heart-racing adventures and Rooftop and Catfish possibly find?

programme.title: E1 - Lionfish
programme.desc: The white sand beaches and emerald green waters of Destin, Florida are the setting for the 'World's Luckiest Fishing Villages.' Beneath the water's surface, it's a different story...one of the most formidable species, the lionfish, has been wreaking havoc on the local ecosystem for decades. The ecological advantage of the lionfish is its venomous spikes, used to corner prey and protect itself from predators, and giving it an advantage over native fish. Luckily, local conservationists and fishing captains discovered years ago that lionfish are as tasty as they are dangerous. Yia joins local biologist Alex Fogg as he works to mitigate the lionfish's damage by harvesting them one buttery, flaky bite at a time.

programme.title: E3
programme.desc: 2035年，與人類形象無異的仿生人由於發展過快，引發公眾的擔憂。“明眸”組織專門負責仿生人案件，組員程諾頭腦冷靜，安秋善於共情，面對仿生人不斷被害，兩人聯手揭開謎團。眾生煙火，仿生人間。人類和仿生人的命運都正在被悄悄改寫......

programme.title: E5
programme.desc: 一個厭世新鮮人意外進入監獄成為管理員，同時監獄也有一群迫不得已在此工作的夥伴，每天面臨各種光怪陸離的遭遇。

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: E13
programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇。

programme.title: Sleazy Dizzy
programme.desc: Lung was an informer of Police in the triad society. But his identity was exposed and lost all memory after hurt. All of money that given by the Police was lost. The Police suspicious Lung had hidden the money. So he was wanted by the triad society and Police. Sing was a little thief, he knew Lung and made friend together. He knew everything about Lung then, and he wanted to help Lung to recover his memory aimed to take back the money. Fong was a manger in a big firm. He had stolen a large amount of money of his firm and was discovered by his colleague later. So he wanted to kill Wu but failed. Fong also wanted the money of Lung, as a result, he wanted to kill Lung also. Wu was saved by Lung and Sing. The Boss of Fong knew everything were exposed and ordered Koo to kill Lung, Sing and Wu. But Wu won't do that because of their friendship...

programme.title: Long And Winding Road
programme.desc: A story about two different men each finding their true meanings in life. LESLIE and TONY, two lower middle-class bachelors, are bosom friends. Leslie is a wandering soul who seems unable to settle down. He got fired and his girlfriend left him. Tony is a frustrating musician and a part-time worker at an elderly home. He doesn't like old people, but works there only to get close to his dream girl WAI...

programme.desc: 刑警何遠航（潘粵明 飾）與其徒弟冉方旭（王鶴棣 飾）調查一起涉及徐家父女的神秘失蹤案。1997年，二人在元龍里小區電梯口失蹤，冉方旭最初認定案件為惡意逃債，但2006年，徐父的遺體被意外發現，推翻了這一結論。 近十年後，何遠航的女兒、已成為警察的何曉荷（任敏 飾）發現案件與過往線索的關聯。她與父親聯手，欲在小區拆遷前夕最終揭露真相。

Breaking News
programme.desc: A TV news unit live broadcasts the embarrassing defeat of a police battalion by five bank robbers. Later, Inspector Rebecca decides to turn the stakeout into a breaking news show.

programme.title: Line Walker
programme.desc: When undercover agent Ding receives an encrypted message from Blackjack, who claims to be an undercover agent that has lost contact with the police, she reports it to her superior officer Inspector Q, who immediately launches a mission to search for Blackjack. During the mission, Ding visits a casino where she discovers that the supposedly dead triad leader Foon-hei is surprisingly alive and kicking. Meanwhile, Inspector Q narrows down Blackjack's whereabouts when he learns of a finance group's involvement in a drug deal in Brazil. The deal involves company chairman Kwok Ming, his advisor Lam, Lam's right-hand man Shiu and Foon-hei, who is plotting a comeback to the crime world. When the players learn of an undercover agent in their midst, paranoia and distrust begin to cloud over the deal...

programme.title: Adventure of The King
programme.desc: Emperor Zhengde of the Ming Dynasty is young and playful, privately escapes from Palace to avoid the appointed marriage. He loses his memory by accident and luckily comes across Ms. Li to take care him. Prince Ningxia takes this opportunity to rebel the kingdom and catch the emperor to execute him immediately at the execution ground. At a critical time, three entourages rescue the Emperor and the prince Ningxia is arrested. However, Ms Li has refused to get marriage with the emperor due to his cheating on her love feelings.
